summary: Lanvin Group filed a Form 6-K announcing it will release audited full-year 2025 results on April 30, 2026, and hold a conference call and webcast that day. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activism, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change is disclosed. The filing is a routine earnings release notification by a foreign private issuer, incorporated by reference into existing registration statements. It provides no deal terms, premium, stake, or structural mechanics. There is no risk-arb angle; the only watch point is the earnings release and call.
